what: A row of photo cells at staggered heights stays pinned to the screen and, over a scroll of row width + 2 screens, flows left by its own width, while a wordmark larger than the screen behind it (42vw, 5% opacity) drifts the opposite way by 80vw. Each cell starts 600px to the right and trails in to a spot at −100 to −180px on an overlapping 4s sine.out curve (starting 85–95% before the previous cell ends), all tied into one timeline with scrub 1 — so the cells follow late and by different distances, and the row scatters diagonally and regroups. Below 1024px it becomes a horizontal row you push by hand
ease: sine.out (follows the cell, scrub 1) · none (line flow)

options.from: Distance from the right where cells start (px), default 600
options.laps: How many % before the previous cell ends the next cell starts (comma-separated), default 90,90,85,90,85,95,90,85
options.dur: Curve length of one cell (timeline share), default 4
options.tail: Length (px) by which the line is pulled narrower than its own width, default screen width × .075
options.narrow: At or below this width the row is swiped by hand (px), default 1024

from.where: index.html photo band (original p-gallery: cell x 600 → −180…−150 · 4s sine.out overlap −=85~95% · scrub 1 · wordmark −80vw)
